summary.text: Larry Brewster is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 43, where Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2020, and a U.S. Army veteran seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Rudolf Haden.
He worked at NorthWestern Energy from 1982 to 2017 and previously served on the Billings City Council and the Billings Public Schools board.

paragraphs.text: Brewster served in the U.S. Army from 1969 to 1972 and attended Idaho State University.
His career experience includes working at NorthWestern Energy from 1982 to 2017.
Brewster previously served six years on the Billings Public Schools District Board and 11 years on the Billings City Council.
In the Montana House, he was assigned in 2025-2026 to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, Rules, Local Government and Taxation committees, chairing the Local Government Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
